back.es: su = his, her, its, their, your (formal usted/ustedes); possessive determiner used before a singular noun
back.example: Her (or his/their/your) house is very big.

note: The prompt really only needs the bare word su, since "car" is singular and rules out sus; the example is ambiguous out of context, so "Her" is just one correct reading among his/her/their/your, and the editor may want to mention the plural form sus somewhere.
